# References {.unnumbered}

The results this book states are, with few exceptions, results that belong to
the literature rather than to the toolkit, and where that is so the source is
cited at the point of use rather than reproduced. The list below collects those
sources. It is deliberately short: it names the paper or the book where a reader
who wants the argument in full will find it, and prefers a standard textbook
treatment to the original announcement wherever the textbook is the more useful
place to be sent.

::: {#refs}
:::
